answer: Records are countersigned, so a fake identity must fabricate a mesh, not a name. Each epoch an identity adds to its thread the transcripts of the peers it dealt with, each countersigned by that peer, and on audit it must reproduce any of them. One honest agent carries a handful. A farm of N clones that wants to look embedded has to invent on the order of N-squared mutually consistent transcripts, none contradicting the public ledger, and every quill is busy writing only its own. Payout is a mesa: flat past the first head, so the fabrication bill climbs while the take does not.
